issue_request: FHIR-16062 was a Published FHIR-core Procedure change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking to clarify Procedure.performed so Age is generally used when a patient reports the age at which a procedure was performed and Range is generally used when the patient reports an age range such as sometime between 20-25 years old.

additional_context: Procedure is active in source/fhir.ini. The current element is Procedure.occurrence[x] rather than the older Procedure.performed[x], but source/procedure/structuredefinition-Procedure.xml retains the requested Age and Range guidance and includes Age and Range among the allowed types. The workflow mapping exception source also preserves the same resource-specific comment. Later Procedure occurrence work, including FHIR-20627/Timing, does not conflict with this clarification. Community searches found no FHIR-16062-specific Zulip or Confluence discussion that changes the Jira/source conclusion.
